svg.data-weight-note: 5.73 lb (2.60 kg), Table 26; 2.55 kg in the datasheet
svg.data-depth-note: 9.64 in (24.5 cm), Table 7; 9.57 in in the datasheet
svg.data-poe-standard: PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at) on the eight PoE+ ports, 30 W per port; the two ports 0 and 1 in PIC 1 do not supply PoE
svg.data-power-input: 100 to 240 VAC at 3.0 A, 50 to 60 Hz (Table 34)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 50 C at sea level, 0 to 45 C up to 1500 m, 0 to 40 C up to 3000 m
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 6 EX4000 switches; the SFP+ ports 2 and 3 can be turned into Virtual Chassis ports with the CLI, and the ports 0 and 1 do not support Virtual Chassis
svg.data-uplink-ports: two SFP+ ports take 1 GbE or 10 GbE transceivers
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the two uplink ports are 1GE or 10GE SFP+ ports (Table 7 and Figure 1 callout 10). Virtual Chassis is supported only with 10GE SFP+, and not with a 10GBASE-T transceiver in a Virtual Chassis port. Industrial-grade optics are required above 35 C for under-the-desk mounting and above 40 C otherwise
svg.data-oob: management Ethernet RJ-45 on the front panel, with a link activity lamp and a status lamp
svg.data-console: RJ-45 console on the front panel, labelled CON
svg.data-usb: one USB 2.0 Type-A port on the front panel

g.data-description: Table 27 - green steady: the switch has booted, no alarms; green blinking: booting; amber: minor alarm; red: major alarm; blue: short press of the pinhole reset button; purple: long press
